name: Coffee Pub Squire
tagline: Play your character from a tray, not the sheet.
description: A token-following character tray with portrait, health, conditions, abilities, items and spells, click-to-roll, synced favorites and gear builds. Adds item transfers with optional GM approval and a party view with GM tools.
pitch: Run your character from a tray that follows your token: roll attacks, spells and items, track health, and manage gear without opening the sheet.

features.title: Token-following tray
features.text: Shows the selected character's portrait, health, conditions, and abilities along the left edge; players get their own character automatically.

features.title: Roll from the tray
features.text: Click a row to attack, cast, or use an item; hover for the D&D 5e item card.

features.title: Favorites and filters
features.text: Favorites shared with the sheet, list or tiles; section tabs, cost chips, equipped and prepared switches.

features.title: Gear builds, costumes
features.text: Plan gear on a paper doll, equip a set in one click; costumes change portrait and token only.

features.title: Item transfers
features.text: Drag items to party members or use the row menu; can route through the GM for approval.

features.title: Party view and cleanup
features.text: Party health and reputation, GM XP, votes and deploy tools, sheet cleanup with undo, NPC statblock checks.

steps: Enable Coffee Pub Blacksmith and Squire; open the tray with the caret on the left-edge handle and pin it to keep it open.
Point the tray at a character: GMs select a token; players get their character automatically.
Use the Character tab: click a row's die to roll or use an item, the heart to favorite, and check the Party tab for party health and tools.
needs: Optional: Coffee Pub Librarian for quests and codex
